gaps.explanation: The budgetary comparison schedules count insurance proceeds and sale of surplus as Local receipts, while the governmental funds statement (trimmed p4) prints them under Other Financing Sources (Insurance proceeds 11,962, Sale of surplus 24,828 = other_financing 36,790). General Fund: budget schedule (p8) Local 948,575 vs statement/combining (p4, p5) Local 927,410 = 21,165 = Insurance proceeds 11,962 + Sale of surplus 9,203. Road Fund: budget schedule (p9) Local 26,558 vs statement (p4) Local 10,933 = 15,625 = Sale of surplus 15,625. 21,165 + 15,625 = 36,790 = the gap (schedule 9,433,063 - statement 9,396,273). Both printed totals are as printed (General budget Total Receipts 6,689,121 p8 vs statement 6,837,256 incl. Inheritance Tax Fund 169,300 -> 6,667,956 + 21,165 = 6,689,121; Road budget 1,528,238 p9 vs statement 1,512,613 + 15,625). No detail fix.
